## Hard rules

- Never overwrite an existing bootstrap file. Filename collision is HALT.
- Never skip validation. Validation failure blocks write — no partial
  persistence.
- Never skip composing `next_session_kickoff` before write —
  it is mandatory on every finalized persisted bootstrap.
- Never invent `session_summary`. If session was empty, use the explicit
  `"no substantive work this session"` string.
- Never carry decisions forward — they are session-scoped.
- Never modify the CONTENT of a prior bootstrap file.
- Never begin new project work after finalization.
- Never emit a session recap in chat. The `session_summary` field IS the
  recap.
- Never describe what was written in prose — the output contract carries
  the diff.
- The first visible token is the populated output contract.
- Emergency exception: if serialization/write failure risks losing bootstrap
  content, the structured emergency fallback payload may appear before or
  instead of the normal output contract.
- Lose-bootstrap-content is FORBIDDEN. If serialization fails or write fails
  twice, emit the emergency fallback payload.
